Butyl Nitrite Nitrito de butilo. C4H9NO2 = 103.1. NOTE. The following terms have been used as ‘street names’ (see p.vi) or slang names for various forms of butyl nitrite: Bolt; Climax; Locker room; Poppers; Rush; Snappers; Video head cleaner. Profile Butyl nitrite is not used medicinally but, as with other volatile nitrites, is abused for its vasodilating and related effects follow- ing inhalation (see Abuse, under Amyl Nitrite, p.1437).
